title: ETC European Tourism Trends and Prospects: Q3/2026
text:
Webinar

ETC European Tourism Trends and Prospects: Q3/2026

Register Now

21 October 2026 – 2.30pm CEST

online

Heatwaves, economic pressures, and geopolitical uncertainty all featured in this summer’s travel season.

Tourism Economics will open with the latest data on Europe’s summer performance at regional and destination level. MMGY TCI Research will then examine how this summer’s heatwaves and droughts affected online sentiment and destination reputation. Tourism Economics will close with an outlook for the winter season, including how energy costs could affect travel demand.

This webinar is being held on our new platform, ON24. If you do not receive your confirmation email, please check your junk and spam folders.

Speakers

Chloe Parkins

Chloe is a Lead Economist with Tourism Economics, specialising in European tourism forecast services. On top of forecasting, she takes a key role in European consultancy work including regular outputs for the ETC and STR. She previously worked on both the industry and macro services within Oxford Economics for seven years where she developed her skills in forecasting, modelling, data visualisation and bespoke consulting work.

Lead Economist, Tourism Economics

Diego Maldonado

Diego Maldonado, a seasoned traveller and Research Director at MMGY-TCI Research, has spent the past four years delving deep into the dynamic world of travel and tourism data. With a background in international project management spanning several years, Diego’s true passion lies in weaving together diverse data sources to craft compelling narratives.

MMGY-TCI Research

Jennifer Iduh

Jennifer Iduh is currently Head of Research & Insights at ETC, a non-profit organisation responsible for the promotion of Europe as a tourist destination in third markets. In that capacity, Jennifer is responsible for research and reporting into different source markets and the identification of key trends and opportunities for European tourism. Jennifer is also in charge of research activities linked to the European Commission (EC) and other research partners such as the World Tourism Organisation (UNWTO), the World Travel and Tourism Council and the European Tourism Association (ETOA), amongst others.

Head of Research & Insights at ETC
